    NtfyLog4j2Installer.uninstall(org.apache.logging.log4j.core.LoggerContext context, NtfyLog4j2Appender appender)
    Reverses NtfyLog4j2Installer.install(LoggerContext): deregisters the reconfiguration listener, detaches the appender from the root logger by name, refreshes the loggers and stops the appender (which flushes any pending digest and drains the async queue).
